claim: the round-33 recipe, unchanged -- the causal baseline every knockout is read against
rationale: control

claim: extrude supplies the protrusion force; removing it collapses the forced protrusion
rationale: R1 read every protrusion as FORCED (p_ratio 1.8-42.9, body drainage) and extrude is the prime suspect. This is the highest-value lever-map entry: if it collapses, extrude is the forcing op and any residual bulge is the campaign's first candidate GROWN mid-surface. REFUTED if protr_peak >= 2.0 -- then the force lives in divide_3d/morphogen, not extrude.

claim: growth is not what drives the round-33 protrusion; mechanics-only leaves peak height essentially intact
rationale: The mirror of the -extrude knockout and the direct test of R1's 'forced, never grown' verdict: if height is set by mechanics, removing the morphogen growth field should not collapse it. REFUTED if protr_peak <= 1.5 -- growth was load-bearing after all and the forced reading is wrong.

claim: cell_geometry_3d is inert per-frame bookkeeping, not a driver; its removal does not change protrusion height
rationale: Genuinely uncalled: cell_geometry_3d either is passive shape bookkeeping (my bet) or is the geometric substrate every mechanical op reads, in which case its knockout silently destroys the tube. With all solo effects 'insufficient' this is a foundational lever-map entry. REFUTED if protr_peak <= 1.5 or ta_n_tubes_final == 0.

claim: adding Hertwig-rule (long-axis) oriented division feeds cells into the elongating protrusion and sustains at least one tube
rationale: Division along the cell long axis is a canonical tube-elongation mechanism; cells born in an elongating protrusion should extend it rather than widen the body. REFUTED if ta_n_tubes_final == 0 or protr_final < control protr_final.

claim: a uniform volume ramp channels into a grown bulge that still registers elevated protr_peak, rather than merely inflating the sphere
rationale: R1 found NO grown (p_ratio~1) regime anywhere on this substrate; uniform growth is the most direct way to add mass without a forcing extrusion. Whether it forms a tube or just swells the body is exactly the uncalled question the map needs. REFUTED if protr_peak < 1.5 -- uniform growth only inflates and the grown-tube regime is still unfound.
